newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - December 5.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - December 5.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had one large one-day net miss in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokesman said.
The miss occured on Monday, resulting in more reserves in the banking system. It was due to treasury balances at the Fed being lower than expected.
The high in natural float was about $1.1 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $625 million on Wednesday.
Transportation float averaged about $30 million per day, with the high on Wednesday at a bit under $100 million primarily due air traffic delays in the St Louis and Minneapolis areas.
